caption: The drawing is a design composed of several sections and patterns with vivid colors. The left and central part of the drawing features two large, cloud-like, symmetrical forms outlined in green and red, both filled with stylized florals and leaf-like motifs in blue, white, brown, yellow, and black on a vegetative dotted pale green background. The upper form contains a blue flower with green leaves and smaller red and white elements, while the lower form has brown, yellow, and red accents arranged in a symmetric floral manner. Between them, the center displays an intricate geometric motif with swirling yellow, red, brown, and black colors, flanked on either side by blue, circular berry-like clusters. The right side of the drawing is divided into four triangles on a blue ground—each includes either floral designs dominated by red and brown petals or fragments of other pattern forms, all surrounded by areas of white with small blue dots. The entire composition is framed by an off-white border, with printed markings "A-1653-b" and the handwritten name "Ruth M. Barnes" at the bottom.
title: Quilted Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
